title: Simple BBQ Chicken Salad
intro: Simple quick and easy salad using up some leftovers.

groups.label: la salsa
items: Dijon mustard but I probably just used some yellow mustard
white wine vinegar (or apple cider vinegar)
Freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.label: Sort the chicken
instructions: Mix the herbs, spices, seasonings and some oil and coat the chicken.
Cook it. I put it in the airfryer but you can chuck it in a pan.

steps.label: Chop the veg
instructions: With the chicken in, wash and chop the veg.

steps.label: A dressing?
instructions: Whisk together the mustard, honey, and vinegar until they are well combined.
Slowly drizzle in the olive oil while whisking to help it emulsify
Add a pinch of salt and black pepper to taste. Adjust the sweetness and tanginess as needed by adding a little more honey or vinegar.

sections.text: As always most of these things come about because I'm trying to use up things in the fridge and don't/can't spend more money!
